goal: Complete on-device E2E validation for gateway cutover with bearer->cookie transition, 401/403 UX behavior, and lifecycle stability evidence.

inputs.description: Canonical Android project path in the same repository.
Optional Android Studio workspace alias path.
Fixed HTTPS endpoint for runtime E2E.
Previous Android partial result (device E2E pending).

constraints.notes: Execute from android/NarrativeLoopMobile (canonical). If alias path is used in Android Studio, report both canonical and alias paths in evidence.

acceptance: First bearer-authenticated request succeeds and session cookie issuance is evidenced.
Cookie-only follow-up requests succeed without auth regression.
401/403 UX behavior and lifecycle smoke (tab switch/background/foreground) are evidenced on device.

risk.note: Device/WebView cookie behavior mismatch can still block final acceptance even when build tests pass.

next_actions: Submit result.json with device checklist, logs, and screenshots or reproducible evidence paths.
If gateway timeout or auth mismatch occurs, include exact failing step and response evidence.
Hand off device E2E evidence to CT for final strict decision.
